mapper.sql: id, actor_id, action, object_type, object_id, result, detail, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into audit_event (id, actor_id, action, object_type, object_id, result, detail, created_at) values (#{id}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{result}, #{detail}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select from audit_event order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
